zh-CN.title: 欢迎消息支持快速排序
items: 长按欢迎消息即可前移、后移或删除，文字消息还可以直接复制
首尾消息会自动禁用无效的移动方向

en.title: Welcome messages can now be reordered quickly
items: Long-press a welcome message to move or delete it, with copy available for text messages
Unavailable move directions are disabled automatically for the first and last messages
